profile.description:
GLM 5.3 Flash is Z.ai's natively multimodal flash model, a 320B-A18B mixture-of-experts released under the MIT license that approaches the larger GLM 5.3 on coding and agentic work. It accepts text, image, and video input with a 1M token context, always-on reasoning at low, high, or max effort, native web search, and function calling.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
